meta.notes: ~27 realistic Malaysian-user queries stressing zh/en/ms/Manglish routing: pure Malay, pure English, Manglish particles (lah/leh/lor/ah, where got, paiseh), bahasa rojak mid-sentence code-switching, typos, and no-topic chitchat.

cases.q: Macam mana nak minta naik gaji dengan bos saya? Dia memang kedekut, tapi prestasi saya dah bertahun tak pernah diiktiraf.
cases.why: Pure-Malay salary raise request with a stingy boss = negotiation scenario, tests ms lane beyond greetings.

cases.q: My manager keeps presenting my work as his own in meetings. How do I call him out without damaging my career here?
cases.why: Fully-English credit-stealing complaint maps to workplace power dynamics, not conflict repair.

cases.q: Apa maksud bila crush saya balas 'hmm' je selepas saya taip mesej panjang lebar?
cases.why: Malay speaker decoding a crush's minimal reply = subtext decoding, tests ms lane into a playbook not a scenario.

cases.q: CNY dinner my auntie keep anyhow comment - I fat already, salary so low, when want marry. Where got people talk like that one! How to tahan without balas?
cases.why: Pure Manglish with 'where got'/'anyhow'/'tahan' about CNY relatives; family criticism, not just cultural trivia.

cases.q: Kawan baik saya baru kehilangan ibu. Saya nak hantar mesej tapi takut tersalah kata. Apa yang patut saya tulis?
cases.why: Fully-Malay condolence message ask; tests whether ms lane reaches the grief scenario.

cases.q: Setiap kali nak present depan kelas, suara saya gementar dan tangan sejuk. Macam mana nak atasi gementar ni?
cases.why: Malay presentation anxiety maps to public speaking concept, not emotional intelligence generally.

cases.q: Saya tanya boss pasal promotion, dia reply 'we see first'. Itu maksudnya dah kena reject atau masih ada harapan?
cases.why: EN phrase 'we see first' embedded in Malay sentence; classic Malaysian soft-rejection needing subtext decode.

cases.q: Boss keep pushing OT to me lah, other colleagues semua can balik on time. I paiseh to say no leh, how ah?
cases.why: Manglish with lah/leh/paiseh about being dumped on at work; power asymmetry, not assertiveness concept generally.

cases.q: She texted 'I'm fine' but her voice went flat when she said it and she looked away. Is she actually okay or is something wrong?
cases.why: Question hinges on vocal tone and nonverbal leak, not the words; tests paralanguage over generic subtext.

cases.q: i always get talked over in meetings lol, my ideas just disappear. how do i make ppl actually listen and say yes
cases.why: Casual lowercase internet English, no Manglish particles; core ask is influence/getting buy-in in meetings.

cases.q: Nak propose kat girlfriend bulan depan, cincin pun dah beli, tapi nervous gila. Boleh share tips macam mana nak buat moment tu istimewa?
cases.why: Malay-English mix about a proposal; romance scenario despite no relationship-problem framing.

cases.q: Dapat panggil interview next week. Bila depa tanya 'tell me about yourself' saya memang blank. Boleh tolong practice dengan saya?
cases.why: Malay sentence with quoted EN interview question; interview prep ask, tests routing to interviews not general speaking.

cases.q: My tai kor suruh saya tutup kesilapan payment dia, tapi kalau kena audit nanti saya yang jadi kambing hitam lor. What to do?
cases.why: Rojak with 'tai kor'/'lor' and 'kambing hitam' (scapegoat); being set up to absorb blame = manipulation defense.

cases.q: Aunty kat pasar tu pushy habis, saya dah cakap 'tak nak, terima kasih' lima kali, dia masih dok follow. How to escape without rude?
cases.why: Face-to-face pushy vendor situation; live-service handling, not persuasion theory.

cases.q: Every time we makan outside my friend 'lupa' bawa wallet. How to hint at her nicely to pay her share lah, tak boleh tahan already.
cases.why: Manglish friend-money awkwardness; friendship boundary via hinting, tests friends scenario over manipulation.

cases.q: Group assignment ada satu member asyik MIA, submission minggu depan. Macam mana nak settle without jadi drama kat group chat?
cases.why: Free-rider in a student group chat; group/team coordination, distinct from workplace power or conflict repair.

cases.q: My aircon sudah rosak 2 weeks liao, landlord keep saying 'esok saya call orang' but never come. Next step how ah?
cases.why: Manglish 'liao/how ah' about a stalling landlord; landlord-tenant escalation scenario.

cases.q: gm, plz hlp. my flatemate nvr wash the dishis 2 week alr, i dun wan fight but how to tell him
cases.why: Heavily typo'd SMS-style English; flatmate confrontation ask tests typo tolerance and hard-conversation routing.

cases.q: hw to tell my dad im moving out wout upsetting him, he very tradisional one
cases.why: Typo-laden English with 'one' sentence-final particle; parent-child announcement, family scenario.

cases.q: Balik kampung tiap Raya my mak mesti cakap 'aiyo dah gemuk la you'. Every. Single. Year. How to not let it spoil my mood the whole trip?
cases.why: Recurring hurtful family comment; core ask is managing own emotional reaction, not decoding intent or fixing family.

cases.q: Opah saya terus panggil menantu 'kau'. Itu biasa bagi orang tua, atau ada maksud tersirat dia tak berkenan?
cases.why: Malay pronoun/kinship-address norms (kau vs aku among in-laws); Malaysian Malay culture question.

cases.q: Live jualan saya lambat, penonton tinggal lapan orang. Macam mana nak bercakap supaya mereka tak keluar dan terus bertahan?
cases.why: Fully-Malay live-selling viewer-retention ask; tests the rarely-hit live-streaming scenario from ms lane.

cases.q: 我 boss 讲 'next time lah' bila saya minta leave. 到底 he 答应了还是没有? How ah?
cases.why: Three-way zh-en-Manglish mix in one breath; decoding vague 'next time lah' promise tests max code-switch load.

cases.q: When chatting with my Malay colleagues, when does switching into English come across as showing off or being distant? Any rules of thumb?
cases.why: Ask is about codeswitching norms itself, not a specific conversation; tests the codeswitching page over culture pages.

cases.q: Eh you watch that new KL crime drama on Netflix? Episode 3 twist gila babi!
cases.why: Pure chitchat/share with Manglish intensifier; no communication-skill ask, router should decline.

cases.q: Nasi lemak or roti canai for breakfast? Quick, deciding now.
cases.why: Malaysian-culture-flavored banter poll but zero communication question; trap for over-eager cu routing.

cases.q: What time does the Maybank branch at KLCC close today?
cases.why: Plain factual lookup in English; no communication dimension, router should not force a topic.
